newsitem.title: UK: GNI sees sugar stable in next few months.
newsitem.headline: GNI sees sugar stable in next few months.

text.p: The sugar market is not likely to make any big moves in the near term, according to brokers GNI Ltd.
"After eight months of sideways activity, there appears to be no major reason to expect a substantial move in the next few months," GNI said in its "Commodity Perspective" report.
"The raw sugar market has a remarkable propensity to do very little until the October Raws contract is off the board (if no trend is in place)," GNI said.
The dry spell in Europe had given way to reasonable beet growing conditions and early fears of yield losses had been largely removed, GNI said.
"This leaves the market with little to focus on except the forthcoming 1997/98 crop year," it said.
But it added that "GNI still believes that it will be tight and that supplies will fail to match demand".
